recommendations.name: Mergify
recommendations.description: Mergify is a tool that allows you to configure risk-based auto-merge policies for your GitHub repositories, ensuring that low-risk pull requests are automatically merged while holding high-risk ones for human review.

recommendations.name: GitHub Actions with a custom workflow
recommendations.description: You can create a custom GitHub Actions workflow that uses a combination of checks and rules to determine the risk level of a pull request and decide whether to automatically merge it or hold it for human review.

recommendations.name: Merge Queue feature in GitHub
recommendations.description: GitHub's native Merge Queue feature allows you to enable auto-merge for pull requests, which will automatically merge them when all required reviews and status checks pass, helping to streamline your workflow.
